scope: Continuation of three actual archived 100-night victories through ordinary postgame and paid hiring commands. Native terrain; no overrides to balance, growth, FIFO, route, damage or history. Fifteen simulated seconds warmup then twenty measured, tick=0.1 seconds; alternating reference/candidate order each step. Setup, checkpoint validation/serialization/hash, events collection and file IO excluded from tick timing. CPU simulation costs, not rendering frametimes, FPS, GPU, RAM, phone or a current-balance 100-night campaign.
